categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: Carries the Mempool label and fixes incorrect eviction of valid BIP68 transactions and their descendants from the mempool during reorg processing in MaybeUpdateMempoolForReorg.
categories.rationale: Fixes an issue where valid transactions spending unconfirmed inputs are incorrectly dropped from the mempool during reorgs. As demonstrated in #35007, stale cached lockpoints evaluated against the disconnected tip caused removeForReorg to treat sequence locks as unsatisfied and evict transactions prematurely rather than recalculating them at the new tip.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Changes src/validation.cpp, but only within MaybeUpdateMempoolForReorg to adjust mempool eviction policy; it does not change consensus validation rules, block verification, or chainstate management.
categories.rationale: The validation category explicitly excludes changes whose primary subject is mempool policy even when they touch files under src/validation.
